title: 5.9.1: Exercises
originalText:
For the following exercises, determine if the points are solutions to the given system of equations.

Exercise \(\PageIndex{1}\)

\({\left\{ \begin{array}{*{20}{rcl}}{2x - 6y}&{ = }&{0}\\{3x - 4y}&{ = }&{5}\end{array}\right.}\quad\quad{\begin{array}{*{20}{l}}{\text{A: }(3,1)}\\ {\text{B: }( - 3,4)}\end{array}}\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{2}\)

\({\left\{ \begin{array}{*{20}{rcl}} { - 3x + y}&{ = }&{8} \\ { - x + 2y}&{ = }&{ - 9} \end{array}\right.}\quad\quad{\begin{array}{*{20}{l}}{\text{A: }( - 5, - 7)}\\ {\text{B: }( - 5,7)} \end{array}}\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{3}\)

\({\left\{ \begin{array}{*{20}{rcl}}{x + y}&{ = }&{2}\\{y}&{ = }&{\frac{3}{4}x}\end{array}\right.}\quad\quad{\begin{array}{*{20}{l}}\text{A: }\left( {\frac{8}{7},\frac{6}{7}} \right)\\ \text{B: }\left( {1,\frac{3}{4}} \right)\end{array}}\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{4}\)

\({\left\{ \begin{array}{*{20}{rcl}}{2x + 3y}&{ = }&{6} \\ {y}&{ = }&{\frac{2}{3}x + 2}\end{array}\right.}\quad\quad{\begin{array}{*{20}{l}}\text{A: }( - 6,2)\\ \text{B: }( - 3,4)\end{array}}\)

For the following exercises, solve the following systems of equations by graphing.

Exercise \(\PageIndex{5}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{- x + y}&{ = }&{2}\\{2x + y}&{ = }&{ - 4}\\ \end{array} \right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{6}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{*{20}{rcl}}{y}&{ = }&{x - 2} \\ {y}&{ = }&{ - 3x + 2} \end{array}\right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{7}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{y}&{ = }&{\frac{2}{3}x - 2}\\{y}&{ = }&{ - \frac{1}{3}x - 5} \end{array} \right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{8}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{- x + 3y}&{ = }&{3}\\{x + 3y}&{ = }&{3}\end{array} \right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{9}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{2x - y}&{ = }&{4}\\{2x + 3y}&{ = }&{12}\end{array}\right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{10}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{ - x + 2y}&{ = }&{ - 6} \\{y}&{ = }&{ - \frac{1}{2}x - 1}\end{array} \right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{11}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{3x + 5y}&{ = }&{10}\\{y}&{ = }&{ - \frac{3}{5}x + 1}\end{array} \right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{12}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{4x}&{ = }&{3y + 7}\\{8x - 6y}&{ = }&{14}\end{array} \right.\)

For the following exercises, solve the systems of equations by substitution.

Exercise \(\PageIndex{13}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{2x + y}&{ = }&{ - 4}\\{3x - 2y}&{ = }&{ - 6}\end{array}\right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{14}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{2x + y}&{ = }&{ - 2 }\\{3x - y}&{ = }&{ 7 }\end{array} \right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{15}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{gathered} x - 2y &=& - 5 \hfill \\ 2x - 3y &=& - 4 \hfill \\ \end{gathered} \right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{16}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{gathered} x - 3y &=& - 9 \hfill \\ 2x + 5y &=& 4 \hfill \\ \end{gathered} \right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{17}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{gathered} - 2x + 2y &=& 6 \hfill \\ \quad\quad\quad\,\,\, y &=& - 3x + 1 \hfill \\ \end{gathered} \right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{18}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{3x + 4y}&{ = }&{1}\\{y}&{ = }&{ - \frac{2}{5}x + 2}\end{array} \right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{19}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{x}&{ = }&{2y}\\{4x - 8y}&{ = }&{0}\end{array} \right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{20}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{y}&{ = }&{\frac{7}{8}x + 4}\\{ - 7x + 8y}&{ = }&{6}\end{array} \right.\)

For the following exercises, solve the systems of equations by elimination.

Exercise \(\PageIndex{21}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{5x + 2y}&{ = }&{2 }\\{- 3x - y}&{ = }&{0 }\end{array} \right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{22}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{6x - 5y}&{ = }&{ - 1 }\\{2x + y}&{ = }&{13 }\end{array} \right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{23}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{2x - 5y}&{ = }&{7 }\\{3x - y}&{ = }&{17 }\end{array} \right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{24}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{5x - 3y}&{ = }&{ - 1 }\\{2x - y}&{ = }&{2 }\end{array} \right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{25}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{3x - 5y}&{ = }&{ - 9 }\\{5x + 2y}&{ = }&{16 }\end{array} \right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{26}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{\frac{1}{3}x - y}&{ = }&{ - 3 }\\{x + \frac{5}{2}y}&{ = }&{2 }\end{array} \right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{27}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{6x + 3y}&{ = }&{9 }\\{2x + y}&{ = }&{3 }\end{array} \right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{28}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{\frac{2}{3}x + y}&{ = }&{5 }\\{2x + 3y}&{ = }&{11 }\end{array} \right.\)

For the following exercises, solve the system of equations by graphing, substitution, or elimination.

Exercise \(\PageIndex{29}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{3x + y}&{ = }&{ - 3 }\\{2x + 3y}&{ = }&{5 }\end{array} \right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{30}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{y}&{ = }&{x + 2 }\\{y}&{ = }&{ - 2x + 2 }\end{array} \right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{31}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{y}&{ = }&{\frac{3}{2}x + 1 }\\{y}&{ = }&{ - \frac{1}{2}x + 5 }\end{array} \right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{32}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{x + y}&{ = }&{ - 4 }\\{- x + 2y}&{ = }&{ - 2 }\end{array} \right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{33}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{- 2x + 3y}&{ = }&{3 }\\{x + 3y}&{ = }&{12 }\end{array} \right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{34}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{x + 3y}&{ = }&{ - 6 }\\{y}&{ = }&{ - \frac{4}{3}x + 4 }\end{array} \right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{35}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{4x - 3y}&{ = }&{8 }\\{8x - 6y}&{ = }&{14 }\end{array} \right.\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{36}\)

\(\left\{ \begin{array}{rcl}{x}&{ = }&{ - 3y + 4 }\\{2x + 6y}&{ = }&{8 }\end{array} \right.\)

For the following exercises, translate to a system of equations and solve.

Exercise \(\PageIndex{37}\)

Jackie has been offered positions by two cable companies. The first company pays a salary of $14,000 plus a commission of $100 for each cable package sold. The second pays a salary of $20,000 plus a commission of $25 for each cable package sold. How many cable packages would need to be sold to make the total pay the same?

Exercise \(\PageIndex{38}\)

Drew burned 1,800 calories Friday playing 1 hour of basketball and canoeing for 2 hours. Saturday she spent 2 hours playing basketball and 3 hours canoeing and burned 3,200 calories. How many calories did she burn per hour when playing basketball? How many calories did she burn per hour when canoeing?

Exercise \(\PageIndex{39}\)

Mitchell currently sells stoves for company A at a salary of $12,000 plus a $150 commission for each stove he sells. Company B offers him a position with a salary of $24,000 plus a $50 commission for each stove he sells. How many stoves would Mitchell need to sell for the options to equal?

Exercise \(\PageIndex{40}\)

The total number of calories in 2 hot dogs and 3 cups of cottage cheese is 960 calories. The total number of calories in 5 hot dogs and 2 cups of cottage cheese is 1,190 calories. How many calories are in a hot dog? How many calories are in a cup of cottage cheese?

Exercise \(\PageIndex{41}\)

Andrea and Bart go to the local farmers market to purchase some fruit. Andrea buys 4 apples and 5 oranges, which cost $3.10; Bart buys 4 apples and 6 oranges, which cost $3.40. What is the cost of an orange? What is the cost of an apple?

Exercise \(\PageIndex{42}\)

Jack and Jill go to a local farmers market to purchase some fruit. Jack buys 3 peaches and 2 limes, which cost $1.50; Jill buys 6 peaches and 5 limes, which cost $3.45. What is the cost of a peach? What is the cost of a lime?
